purpose: One implementation decision about original-burst early-intent versus the strongest reusable legalizer completion-paced organization; not another abstract fee inequality.

inputs.source_version: current bytes bound by this round M/O/root evidence, top input HEAD e79a476c9332d3892a0681957dc85933addda8c5
inputs.program: one fixed normal independent aligned4096 COPY per DMA0/1; only cold/hot input histories; actual frontend start/config prefix; no forced internal state

ordinary_strength: Translate both children as early as legitimately possible, hold L1 in original TC, use existing metadata marker with RAW=0 plus one sticky completion bit; grant same added interfaces. Do not force prepare after V walk.
pass: M-ID timely and correct, preserves full work and required service, and offers a measured full-completion/cost or useful capability difference against best ordinary design. Keep a bounded interface-cost hypothesis, not a paper-complete declaration.
fail: M misses actual window/required timing, or fixed actual program lacks it, or ordinary has equal/better full service at no higher complete measured cost: end this fixed-COPY M-ID cost version. If only an uncalibrated inequality remains, do not pass or launch full system.
